Alongside the ongoing discount on M5 MacBook Air at up to $250 off and AirTag 2 from just $17.50 each, Amazon has now updated its giant early Black Friday sale with an even lower price on  AirPods Pro 3   at $70 off and the lowest prices ever on the entire Apple Watch Series 12 lineup starting from $329. These offers include the first chance to save on Apple’s gorgeous Pearl White Ceramic Series 12 and Apple Watch SE 3 starting from just $199 shipped. Check it all out below and go scoop up the 40W Dynamic Power iPhone Duo fast charger while it’s over 25% off. 

Update 11/16: Amazon’s Apple TV 4K discount is now live again for folks looking to scoop one now that it has officially released.
